items.title: 5.6.1 Viscosity par asar karne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.6.1, printed pages 104-105, with Quick Check 5.5 and answers.

blocks.text: Viscosity par asar karne wale factors yeh hain:

items: Temperature barhane se molecules ki ausat (average) kinetic energy barhti hai. Is energy se molecules aapas ki kashish ki forces par qaboo pa lete hain, is liye viscosity kam ho jati hai. (Garam shehad thande shehad se tez behta hai.)
Intermolecular forces jitni mazboot, liquid ki viscosity utni zyada, kyunke molecules ek doosre ke paas se azadi se nahi guzar sakte aur behne mein rukawat barh jati hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Acetone (CH₃COCH₃), ethanol (C₂H₅OH) aur dimethyl ether (CH₃OCH₃) ko surface tension ki barhti tarteeb mein likhein, wajah ke saath.
blocks.explanation: Surface tension intermolecular forces ke saath barhti hai. Dimethyl ether mein sirf kamzor dipole-dipole forces hain aur koi O−H nahi. Acetone ka C=O zyada polar hai, is liye forces zyada. Ethanol ka O−H hydrogen bonds banata hai. Tarteeb: CH₃OCH₃ < CH₃COCH₃ < C₂H₅OH.

blocks.prompt: b) CCl₄ ki viscosity CHCl₃ se zyada magar ethanol se kam kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: CCl₄ CHCl₃ se bhari aur bara molecule hai, is liye us ki London forces zyada hain aur woh aahista behta hai. Ethanol hydrogen bonds banata hai jo in dono ki forces se mazboot hain, is liye ethanol sab se zyada viscous hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Zyada viscosity wali dawaiyan (drugs) asani se oxidize kyun nahi hotin?
blocks.explanation: Gaarhe (viscous) liquid mein molecules aahista harkat karte hain, is liye hawa ki oxygen andar tak aahista phailti (diffuse hoti) hai aur dawa ke molecules se kam takrati hai. Is liye oxidation ki raftar kam rehti hai aur dawa der tak theek rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Shehad (honey) ki viscosity pani se zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Shehad shakar (sugar) ka bohat gaarha mehlool hai. Shakar ke bare molecules par bohat se O−H groups hain jo aapas mein aur pani se bohat se hydrogen bonds banate hain, is liye shehad behne mein bohat zyada rukawat karta hai.

blocks.prompt: e) Glycerine aur hexane mein kaun zyada viscous hai? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Glycerine. Us ke har molecule mein teen O−H groups hain jo bohat se hydrogen bonds banate hain, jabke hexane mein sirf kamzor London forces hain. (Kitab ne formulas ghalat chhape hain; sahi: glycerine CH₂OHCHOHCH₂OH, hexane C₆H₁₄.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Quick Check 5.5 (e) mein kitab glycerine ko “CH₂OHCH₂OHCH₂OH” aur hexane ko “C₆H₆” likhti hai. Sahi formulas: glycerine CH₂OHCHOHCH₂OH (beech wale carbon par ek hi H hota hai) aur hexane C₆H₁₄ (C₆H₆ benzene hai).

items: Temperature barhe to viscosity kam (zyada kinetic energy); intermolecular forces mazboot hon to viscosity zyada (glycerine, shehad, pani hydrogen bonds ki wajah se gaarhe; hexane patla).
